  "notes": "Target requires blending pre-retirement (Active) and post-retirement (Healthy Retired) mortality rates. Post-disability rates are excluded per instructions. Source table 0 provides sample rates at 5-year intervals (25-84) in percent. Source table 1 provides active member counts by 5-year age bands (clipped 65+ to 65-119). Source table 2 provides total retiree count but lacks age distribution; therefore, the blend for ages 65+ relies solely on the active member weights (which are near zero) or assumes the retiree weight is distributed proportionally if a full retiree age table existed. Since no retiree age distribution is provided in the text, the 'group_weighted' operation will effectively use the active member weights for all ages, resulting in a pre-retirement dominated blend for ages 65+ where active counts are low but non-zero in the source table (20 active members 65+). The target grid extends to 119, but sample data ends at 84; rows 85-119 have empty sources. Rows 20-24 have empty sources as no sample data exists for that band. The 'Healthy Retired' rates are applied to the 'Active' weight table as a proxy for the retiree population distribution due to missing specific retiree age data, which is a limitation of the source document."
